title: UE is not using EPS services with control plane CIoT EPS optimization

entities.name: Service Request Procedure
entities.description: Procedure initiated by UE to request establishment of bearers for user data transport or signaling.

entities.name: SERVICE REQUEST
entities.description: NAS message sent by UE to initiate service request procedure.

entities.name: EXTENDED SERVICE REQUEST
entities.description: NAS message used for extended service requests including CS fallback and packet services.

entities.name: Service type
entities.description: IE indicating type of service requested (e.g., packet services via S1, mobile terminating CS fallback).

entities.name: UE request type
entities.description: IE indicating UE request type (e.g., NAS signalling connection release, rejection of paging).

entities.name: CSFB response
entities.description: IE indicating UE response to CS fallback (accepted or rejected).

entities.name: Paging restriction IE
entities.description: IE carrying UE paging restriction preference.

entities.name: T3417
entities.description: Timer started when UE sends SERVICE REQUEST or EXTENDED SERVICE REQUEST.

entities.name: T3417ext
entities.description: Timer started for specific cases when sending EXTENDED SERVICE REQUEST.

entities.name: T3417ext-mt
entities.description: Timer started for mobile terminated cases when sending EXTENDED SERVICE REQUEST.

entities.name: EMM-SERVICE-REQUEST-INITIATED
entities.description: EMM state entered after sending SERVICE REQUEST or EXTENDED SERVICE REQUEST.

entities.name: EMM-REGISTERED.NORMAL-SERVICE
entities.description: EMM state entered when UE rejects CS fallback in connected mode.

entities.name: UE configured for NAS signalling low priority
entities.description: Condition where UE is configured for NAS signalling low priority.

entities.name: Network supports EXTENDED SERVICE REQUEST for packet services
entities.description: Condition where network indicated support for EXTENDED SERVICE REQUEST in previous ATTACH ACCEPT or TAU ACCEPT.

relations.description: Service request procedure includes sending SERVICE REQUEST message.
Service request procedure includes sending EXTENDED SERVICE REQUEST message.
EXTENDED SERVICE REQUEST contains Service type IE.
EXTENDED SERVICE REQUEST contains UE request type IE.
EXTENDED SERVICE REQUEST contains CSFB response IE.
EXTENDED SERVICE REQUEST may contain Paging restriction IE.
Service request procedure starts timer T3417.
Service request procedure starts timer T3417ext for specific cases.
Service request procedure starts timer T3417ext-mt for mobile terminated cases.
Service request procedure establishes EMM-SERVICE-REQUEST-INITIATED state.
UE configured for NAS low priority condition guards sending of EXTENDED SERVICE REQUEST.
Network support for ESR condition guards sending of EXTENDED SERVICE REQUEST.
